editorialIntro.heading: Curves in Focus
editorialIntro.paragraph: The T80 pairs a compact form with sculptural H-cup curves. MD’s Shape Memory Silicone is included in the build, bringing the high rebound, softness and low-oil formulation described by the manufacturer. At 32cm wide and 6.5kg, this chest torso gives the material a focused expression. Choose the skin and areola finish that suits your collection, then explore the contours and material demonstrations in the complete factory gallery.

editorialIntro.heading: The Unscheduled Meeting
editorialIntro.paragraph: Leona has claimed the corner booth of a nearly empty lounge, her dark hair tucked neatly beneath a black cap. She watches the entrance with a steady gaze, her expression unreadable as she draws her white wrap tighter against the sudden chill. When you finally slide into the brown upholstered chair opposite her, she offers no greeting. Instead, she leans forward, her red-and-black outfit catching the dim light as she gestures for you to listen closely. Her proposition is simple: abandon the crowded reception and find somewhere that serves dinner after midnight. You came prepared for intrigue. Leona came prepared with a reservation.
